House share · Bills Included · Furnished ·

Acorn properties are delighted to offer for rent this newly refurbished house share situated on Windy Nook Road. The accommodation is ideally situated for those needing the Queen Elizabeth Hospital and also for Newcastle City Centre with all the bus routes on Old Durham Road.
